$schema-note: Raw source-shaped fixture, pre-sanitization. mintMark is null on purpose (NBU coins carry no mint mark); the import script normalizes it to ''. Each coin's subject lives in `variety` because the Coin natural key (country, denomination, year, mintMark, variety) has no per-coin name, and several commemoratives share a year and denomination.

sources.note: Fetched through the MediaWiki API; no raw capture saved under sources/. The fetch was truncated (39,767 of 49,177 characters), but the 2016 entry was in the part read. Mintage 60,000 = 10,000 in the 'Монети України' set + 50,000 in souvenir packaging; the article calls it a circulating coin but does not say it entered circulation. Issued 1 Sep 2016, withdrawal from circulation began 1 Oct 2020. Specs (aluminium bronze, 26 mm, 1.85 mm, 6.8 g) equal the file-level specs; the edge inscription 'ОДНА ГРИВНЯ' is not stored. NBU cross-check not done: bank.gov.ua returned HTTP 403. Scope came from the task; nothing is copied from uCoin.

sources.note: Shows that the 2016 '20 років грошовій реформі в Україні' collector set (10,000) contains the 1-50 kopiyky and the 'Volodymyr the Great' 1 hryvnia (ukraine-1-hryvnia.json), not this commemorative coin, so the two keep separate natural keys. No raw capture saved; NBU cross-check not done (HTTP 403).
